entries.4774108f551b3304: As an independent automotive parts manufacturer, it has built an operating base with the supply of parts for new vehicles and the supply of replacement parts as its two main pillars. As medium- to long-term priority strategies, it lists 4 items: responding to electrification, centered on cooling-system parts such as electric water pumps and integrated thermal management modules; responding to customers' global strategies through the start of local production of electric water pumps at the Romania plant and the start-up of new plants in the United States and India; expanding sales of replacement parts by broadening the range of application to large vehicles and construction machinery and continuously introducing new items; and responding to OEM outsourcing, serving as a receiving party when upper-tier parts manufacturers outsource component parts (Tier).
entries.4c8915d10bc1a27d: The company's foundation consists of product development and quality control capabilities, and technological capabilities related to metal processing and cooling systems, developed through many years of transactions with South Korean automakers and automotive parts makers. For replacement parts, the company maintains a wide assortment regardless of manufacturer, model or model year, and by strengthening the balance of quality and price, it supplies GMB-brand products to locations around the world. The company has a sales base that can serve both the new-vehicle parts market and the replacement parts market, which have different demand structures.
